2025-05-27
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while
stopped at a traffic signal. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the
attorney's office.
2025-05-29
Confirmed that the driver of the insured vehicle is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of
loss. Oepned a physical damage file and an injury file.
2025-06-30
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and rceords the rear impact as
described. Requested the photographs taken at the scene for review.
2025-07-01
Reviewed secne photographs. They show damage consistent with the reported impact, and the rear bumper and
trunk area line up with the position of the vehicles as described. No independent witnesses were identified in the
report or by the attorney's office.
2025-07-17
Vehicle inspection completed. The damage pattern matches the described impact and there is no indication of prior
damage to the vehicle. Estimate issued for repairs.
2025-07-22
Received the medical records summary. The reported injury is whiplash, which fits the kind and force of a rear impact
of this type. No prior treatment to the neck or upper back appears in the records requested so far, and no earlier injury
to that area is known to us.
2025-08-25
Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of the collision is consistent with the
police report and with the earlier first notice of loss.
2025-09-15
Follow-up call with the claimant's attorney. The claimant has given the same account in each conversation so far, with
no changes to the sequence of events or the vehicles involved.
2025-10-08
Physical therapy and follow-up visits have continued for longer than is typical for this type of injury. Requested
updated treatment notes and an explanation of the ongoing care plan.
2025-11-28
Reviewed the policy history. Nothing in the file suggests that the damage occurred before the coverage period began.
2025-11-30
Received the updated treatment records and the treating provider's narrative. The narrative attributes the ongoing
symptoms to the collision and describes the course of care in detail. Referred the file for a secondary medical review
of the treatment length.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
